description: This file defines the AOR_Scheduled_Reports class for handling scheduled reports in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for report configuration, methods for email recipient parsing, scheduling logic, and integration with the SugarCRM framework.

classes.name: AOR_Scheduled_Reports
classes.description: Represents a scheduled report within SuiteCRM, providing methods for scheduling, recipient parsing, and permission checks.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the object implements a specific interface, returning true if 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides save to include parsing email recipients before delegating to parent.

methods.name: get_email_recipients
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses based on the serialized email recipients configuration.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines whether the scheduled report should run at the given DateTime, based on cron schedule and last run time.

methods.name: handleTimeZone
methods.description: Adjusts a DateTime object based on the default timezone.

methods.name: parseRecipients
methods.description: Parses and serializes email recipient data from POST request.
